metadata.case_name: LI TIN YAU v. LEUNG CHI TAI AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Employed by Kin Ngai Knitting Factory in operating, maintaining and repairing knitting machinery; also working as a delivery worker (earning $140/day at date of accident)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: intended to return to work in the knitting industry within 6 months
plaintiff.education_level: completed apprenticeship training course (had not completed the technical education portion)

injuries.description: spinal cord injury resulting in traumatic paraplegia; assessed as 100% permanently disabled
source: (g) The Plaintiff's injuries were diagnosed as epidural haematoma and spinal cord injury and on 16th April, 1985 he was assessed as being 100% permanently disabled as a result of traumatic paraplegia.
injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of lumbar spinal cord

injuries.description: left epidural haematoma (required emergency craniotomy and evacuation of the clot)
source: An X-ray of the skull was taken showing a linear fracture of the T12 vertebral body, A C.T. scan of the skull was performed showing a left epidural haematoma. An emergency craniotomy and evacuation of the clot was performed on 28th June, 1983.

injuries.description: linear fracture of the T12 vertebral body
source: An X-ray of the skull was taken showing a linear fracture of the T12 vertebral body, A C.T. scan of the skull was performed showing a left epidural haematoma. An emergency craniotomy and evacuation of the clot was performed on 28th June, 1983.

injuries.description: contusion oedema of the spinal cord with subluxation of the T11 and T12 joint (operative finding at laminectomy)
source: On 2nd July, 1983 a laminectomy was performed at the T11 and T12 level and the operative finding was contusion oedema of the spinal cord with subluxation of the T11 and T12 joint.
injuries.icd_description: Concussion or oedema of thoracic spinal cord

manifestations.description: Paraplegia (no movement in the lower limbs)
Impaired sensation of the lower half of the trunk and lower limbs

treatments_received: Emergency craniotomy and evacuation of the clot (28th June, 1983)
Laminectomy at the T11 and T12 level (2nd July, 1983)

losses.description: Confined to a wheelchair; "to spend the rest of his life in a wheelchair"

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Has been unable to participate in sporting, leisure and social activities since the accident (played football, bowling, badminton, swimming prior to accident)
Unable to participate in social activities such as taking girlfriends to the cinema and eating out
Requires help with bathing, dressing, cooking, laundry and toilet; mother visits to bring food and help with housekeeping

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life

losses.description: Impaired sensation of the lower half of the trunk and lower limbs

comparable_cases.case_name: Lee Ting Lam v. Leung Kam Ming
comparable_cases.injury_description: Court of Appeal reference that the category of 'gross disability' includes paraplegics

comparable_cases.case_name: Lau Che Ping v. Hoi Kong Ironwares
comparable_cases.injury_description: Updated guidelines cited for awards and ranges for categories including gross disability
